components.name: vmapple-memory-reset-and-config
components.guest_visible_purpose: VMApple firmware/config windows, RAM base, ECID, model and reset ordering

source.project: QEMU VMApple machine and config device

port.rationale: The fixed Rust descriptor records guest-visible addresses without importing QOM or GLib.

guest_contract.reset_behavior: fixed graph reset clears counter and device state while preserving topology
guest_contract.mmio_pio_map: QEMU reference: firmware 0x00100000/0x00100000; config 0x00400000/0x00010000; GIC distributor 0x10000000/0x00010000; redistributors 0x10010000/0x00400000; UART 0x20010000/0x00010000; RTC 0x20050000/0x00001000; GPIO 0x20060000/0x00001000; pvpanic 0x20070000/0x2; BDIF 0x30000000/0x00200000; APV 0x30200000/0x20000; AES 0x30220000/0x8000; PCIe ECAM 0x40000000/0x10000000; PCIe MMIO 0x50000000/0x1fff0000; RAM 0x70000000+. Rust descriptor records every fixed window; only firmware/config/GIC/UART/RTC/GPIO/pvpanic/BDIF/APV state has implemented behavior, while AES/PCIe reads return zero and writes fail closed.
guest_contract.register_layout: config version 0x000, CPUs 0x004, ECID 0x018, RAM 0x020, model 0x3c0, SoC 0x404
guest_contract.read_behavior: aligned 1/2/4/8-byte reads only; unknown register reads return zero
guest_contract.write_side_effects: config writes are rejected; reset restores fixed state
guest_contract.timer_behavior: counter state is reset with machine
guest_contract.boot_time_dependency: config must exist before firmware reads ECID/model; graph reset/validity is checked in the same Rust preOS call

references: QEMU hw/vmapple/vmapple.c and hw/vmapple/cfg.c at pinned commit

components.known_gaps: Descriptor reset/validity is wired into the EFI preOS call but the diagnostic JIT has no MMIO dispatch; AES DMA, PCIe enumeration, firmware backing, and PV graphics remain unsupported and their windows fail closed. This is not a physical M1 map.
